brief: docs/PLAN.md §3 W1-05 — roads, signposts, wayfinding without a marker (seam S35 supersedes S30; AR-2)
findings: SURVEY F1: game/data/world/roads.json ships 10 legs (25,056.9 m trunk), 9 waystations, 2 named_routes (crossing 6816 m / 56.8 walk-min; long_way 9367.3 m). There are ZERO signposts anywhere in the repo — grep 'signpost' over game/ and tools/ hits only opacity.js's ROUTE enum, one dialogue note, and a pois.json owner string. The L2 layer of RI-WLD06 does not exist at all.

SURVEY F2: pois.json is STALE against roads.json. pois.json declares 8 waystations with names 'Wayshrine of the Root (Stormhold-Helstrom)', 'Pole Camp', 'Vat-Keeper's Hut', 'Kiln Post'; roads.json's 9 waystations are 'Legion Milepost', 'Ash Shelter', 'Corpse-Lily Shrine' x2, 'Welkynd Shrine', 'Lichen Post', 'Fired-Cold Well', 'Tide-Pole Post', 'Stilt-Rest'. Only 'Tide-Pole Post' and 'Stilt-Rest' agree. build-pois.mjs derives from roads.json, so pois.json was built against an older roads.json and never rebuilt.

SURVEY F3: roads.json waystations are ORPHAN DATA in the running game. Only tools read them (build-pois, build-hearths, scale-audit). Nothing in game/src places or draws a waystation. Same defect class as the 60 books' topics_taught.

SURVEY F4: tools/harness/viewpoints-province.json's 17 viewpoints carry anchor: 'region_blackwood' etc. None of those 13 states exist in game/data/states. They are ALSO never read: the file's own consumer, tools/world/province-shots.mjs, calls loadState('default') and ignores anchor entirely; and shoot.mjs would call hOpt('loadState', ...) which swallows the failure AND the file has 0 viewpoints with a `camera` key, so shoot.mjs cannot shoot it at all. The anchors are orphan fields, not missing states.

SURVEY F5: the renderer consumes roads.json properly — field.setRoads() builds roadSegs/roadGrid/spans, province.js _spans() builds deck slabs, parapets and piers per tile. That is the pattern a signpost consumer must copy: a per-tile procedural build off world data.

SURVEY F6: the pattern for a READABLE world object already exists — engine.openWrit()/_writSync() pushes a model with a `record: {name, lines}` block into renderer.ui.setModel(). A signpost reader can mirror it exactly, which makes the sign's text DRAWN rather than orphan text (RI-JRN07 §CONSUMPTION item 4).

MID-RUN CORRECTION: S30 (no map at all) was OVERRULED BY THE OWNER 2026-08-07 and superseded by S35 — there IS a map, confined to a record of ground already walked, with no marker, route line, distance readout, or square for a place never stood in. Four comments I had already written asserting no map exists were corrected (build-signposts.mjs, province.js _signposts, engine.js signRead, field.js setSignposts). NOTHING in this piece was wasted: S35 states outright that wayfinding must still work with the map closed, because a map showing only where you have been cannot get you anywhere new. Signposts, prose directions and steer-by landmarks are unaffected and are still the whole of this piece.
